bridge_host.label: Bridge IP Address
bridge_host.description: IP address of the Philips Hue bridge, e.g. 192.168.1.50. Find it in the Hue app under Settings > My Hue System > the bridge.

pair.label: Pair with Hue Bridge
pair.description: Press the round button on top of the Hue bridge first, then click here within 30 seconds to retrieve the API credentials.

repair_bridge.label: (Re)Pair with Hue Bridge
repair_bridge.description: Press the round button on top of the Hue bridge first, then click here within 30 seconds to retrieve fresh API credentials.

brightness.label: Overall brightness
brightness.description:
Master brightness for the base light effects, 0-100.
Scales the base Mode only - the strobe has its own brightness limit.
Applies live while music plays.

color_mode.label: Mode (base effect)
color_mode.description:
The base visualization style that runs on every light.
Smooth: spectrum-driven brightness with a slowly drifting palette.
Ambient: colour cycling only, no brightness pulse.
Flashing: a brightness pulse on every beat, stronger on downbeats.
Energetic: big brightness swings on hits plus fast palette rotation.
Club: structure-aware - soft groove pulse in the verse, lights recruited one by one through a build-up, a hard white slam on the drop, and a breathing blackout on breakdowns (adapts to the music automatically; pair with Auto strobe below).
Pulse: dark between beats - on every beat one light fires bright and eases out to black, a different light each beat (a hit chasing around the room), the whole room blooming on the downbeat.
For house/techno sets pick Club or Pulse.

palette.label: Colour palette
palette.description:
Pick a fixed colour palette for the base effects, or 'Music / album colours' to derive them from what is playing.
100 palettes are built in (Disco, Rave, Cyberpunk, Ocean, Sunset, ...). The strobe keeps its own independent colour.

palette_rotate_smooth.label: Smooth palette rotation
palette_rotate_smooth.description:
Only affects palette rotation (set up by dragging palettes into the rotation tray in the live preview).
ON = a short, tempo-locked crossfade (about one beat) glides from one palette to the next.
OFF = a hard cut that snaps the new palette exactly on the bar - punchier and tighter for a clubbing effect, so turn this OFF for hard house/techno sets.
Applies live.

pulse_select.label: Pulse: which light fires
pulse_select.description:
In the Pulse base mode (and the Club groove) one or more lights fire on each beat and ease out to black.
Chase = the hit travels light to light around the room.
Scatter = a random light each beat.
Spectrum = the light mapped to the loudest band fires (the bass light on the kick).

pulse_downbeat.label: Pulse: bloom on the downbeat
pulse_downbeat.description: ON = the whole room flashes together on the first beat of each bar (an accent) and then eases out. OFF = the downbeat fires like any other beat.

pulse_decay.label: Pulse: fade length (%)
pulse_decay.description:
How much of the gap between beats the fire takes to ease from full down to black.
Higher = longer, smoother tails that overlap; lower = snappier with more darkness between hits. 90% leaves a brief black moment so each new hit pops out of darkness.

pulse_floor.label: Pulse: darkness between beats (%)
pulse_floor.description: Brightness the non-firing lights rest at between beats. 0% = full black (maximum punch, the default); raise it for a dim base glow so the room is never completely dark.

strobe_lights.label: Strobe lights
strobe_lights.description:
Tick the individual lights that take part in the strobe. The list shows every light (and every gradient-strip segment) per area as 'Area - Light'.
Spread 2-6 lights across the room for the strongest effect. Leave EMPTY to turn the strobe off.
Example: tick 4 ceiling spots and set coverage to 50% -> each burst flashes 2 random ones while the other 2 keep the base effect, swapping on the next burst.

strobe_coverage.label: Strobe coverage (%)
strobe_coverage.description:
Hard cap on how many of the selected strobe lights may flash at the SAME time: k = round(selected x %/100), at least 1.
With 4 lights: 25% = 1, 50% = 2, 75% = 3. A fresh random subset is picked each burst and never repeats the exact same set twice in a row.
Applies live.

strobe_sensitivity.label: Strobe sensitivity
strobe_sensitivity.description:
How readily the strobe engages.
100 = runs continuously while anything plays. ~70 (default) = fires on drops/choruses and rests during calm parts. Lower = only the biggest energy jumps trigger it.
Applies live.

strobe_enabled.label: Enable strobe
strobe_enabled.description: Master on/off - turn off to pause the strobe without clearing the selection.

strobe_auto.label: Auto strobe (adapts to the music)
strobe_auto.description:
Let the song-structure detector run the strobe instead of the manual sliders. It stays silent through verses and breakdowns, accelerates through build-ups, and hits a hard 1/16-note strobe on the drop, with the flash rate locked to the detected tempo - tuned for house, trance and techno.
While ON, the Sensitivity, Flash rate and Coverage settings below are ignored (Colour, Brightness, Duty and Blackout still apply).
Example: turn this on, tick a few Strobe lights, and leave the rest - pairs perfectly with the Club base mode. Applies live.

strobe_blackout.label: Full blackout between flashes
strobe_blackout.description:
ON = the selected lights go fully black between flashes (maximum contrast, classic club strobe).
OFF = between flashes they fall back to the base effect, so the preset shows through and only the flashing subset blips.

strobe_color.label: Strobe colour
strobe_color.description: Flash colour, independent of the palette and base effects. White = classic strobe.

strobe_brightness.label: Strobe brightness cap (%)
strobe_brightness.description: Maximum brightness of the strobe flashes. Independent of the overall brightness and the per-light brightness, so the strobe always punches through.

strobe_flash_hz.label: Flash rate (Hz)
strobe_flash_hz.description: Flashes per second while engaged. 8-12 reads as a hard club strobe.

strobe_duty.label: Flash duty (%)
strobe_duty.description: How much of each flash period is lit. Lower = shorter, punchier blips with more darkness between them (15-30% is a hard, low-duty strobe).

strobe_min_hold_ms.label: Min hold (ms)
strobe_min_hold_ms.description: Once engaged the strobe stays on at least this long, so it doesn't stutter on a single hit.

strobe_release_ms.label: Release (ms)
strobe_release_ms.description: How long energy must stay low before the strobe disengages and hands lights back to the base effect.

strobe_beat_sync.label: Sync flashes to the beat
strobe_beat_sync.description: Align flashes to the detected beat (the musical subdivision of the beat nearest your flash rate). Falls back to the free-running rate when no beat is detected.

hue_latency_ms.label: Light latency (ms)
hue_latency_ms.description:
How many milliseconds ahead of the audio the lights render, to cancel the Hue bridge + DTLS + network delay.
Increase if the lights LAG the music; decrease if they run AHEAD. Typical 50-400 ms.
Applies instantly (no save) so you can tune it live against the preview.

live_preview.label: Live preview - click the (?) button to open the preview panel.

manifest.description: Sync Philips Hue lights to music using Entertainment Mode.
